name: tia_connect
description: Attach to one running TIA Portal instance by its process ID (from tia_list_processes). The server never attaches on its own, so call this before any project tool. Attaching can block while that TIA Portal instance is busy with a modal dialog (for example a firmware update); pick an idle instance or wait.

process_id.description: Process ID (PID) of the TIA Portal instance to attach to, as listed by tia_list_processes.
